liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Deal** (4 reviews): Reviewer counted 43 repeats of the 'don't you let that deal go down' refrain, calling the jam extremely long; Reviewer finds it easily one of the most energetic versions they've heard, despite not usually loving the song [8][9][10][13]
- **Wharf Rat** (4 reviews): Reviewer calls this one of the most dramatic readings of the song they've heard; Wharf Rat into Sugar Magnolia is singled out as a highlight [8][11][18][19]
- **Jack Straw** (3 reviews): Described as among the best ever, nearly six minutes, with the band playing at fever pitch; Described as thundering, in the first set [10][14][18]
- **Peggy-O** (1 review): Described as a heart-wrenching version [14]

## Setlist highlights

- **New New Minglewood Blues**: rare: 13 archived performances [20]

## The recordings

- **gd1978-04-22.133786.sbd.miller.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 19 songs; 175 min; rated 5/5 by 6 [1]
- **gd78-04-22.sony54p.vernon.12384.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 19 songs; 180 min; rated 2.67/5 by 6 [2]. Said about its sound: This audience source's sound quality is below average, a common issue with audience tapes [11]
- **gd1978-04-22.169184.sony.54p.wagner.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 19 songs; 184 min [3]
- **gd1978-04-22.sonyECM250.walker-scotton.miller.92808.flac16**: source not stated; 19 songs; 164 min; rated 4.91/5 by 11 [6]. Said about its sound: Walker audience source sounds well-balanced and full, a vintage tape revived by digital work; Clear and crisp, with little crowd noise and well-balanced instruments; the other audience source is weaker; Reviewer considers this audience recording so good that a soundboard isn't needed [12][14][18][19]

## Around the show

- Reviewer saw the band twice while at school in Nashville; this was the second show attended, remembered as energetic [8]
- Reviewer attended several shows at the auditorium in the 1990s and found the room acoustically difficult [19]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1978-04-22.133786.sbd.miller.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Set 1: SBD -> Master Cassette -> Dat (44.1k)Set 2: SBD -> Master Reel -> Dat (44.1k) [1]. Also: Joe B. Jones helped pitch-correct the patch source for this soundboard-based release [1]
- **gd78-04-22.sony54p.vernon.12384.sbeok.shnf**: source: Audience Recording: Sony 54P's [2]
- **gd1978-04-22.169184.sony.54p.wagner.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Bob Wagner; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Bob Wagner's Master FOB (10th row) Audience Cassettes; Sony 54p (x3) mics > Nakamichi 550 [3]. Also: Sony ECM250 Walker/Scotton/Miller source patches short gaps in Eyes Of The World and Sugar Magnolia; A soundboard source supplies crowd noise and first notes of Candyman, plus the opening of Deal [3]
- **gd1978-04-22.sonyECM250.walker-scotton.miller.92808.flac16**: taped by Joani Walker; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Sony ECM-250 -> Cassette Master (Sony TC-158/Maxell UDXL-II90) [6]. Also: Charlie transferred and mastered the Walker and Scotton audience recording; Recordings by Walker, Scotton and Miller are praised; Charlie Miller transferred this Walker/Scotton material; Tapes came from Paul Scotton and Joani Walker; Joe B. Jones helped with pitch correction [6][12][17]

## Art and photos

- Poster by RareVinyl.com: [Grateful Dead Dave's Picks Volume 15: Municipal Auditorium, Nashville, TN 4/22/78 2015 US 3-CD set](https://us.rarevinyl.com/products/grateful-dead-dave-s-picks-volume-15-municipal-auditorium-nashville-tn-4-22-78-us-3-cd-album-triple-set-r2550932-790414) [25]
- Poster by RareVinyl.com: [Grateful Dead Dave's Picks Volume 15: Municipal Auditorium, Nashville, TN 4/22/78 2015 US 3-CD set](https://us.rarevinyl.com/products/grateful-dead-dave-s-picks-volume-15-municipal-auditorium-nashville-tn-4-22-78-us-3-cd-album-triple-set-r2550932-790414) [26]
